w1_requirement_axis.interpretation: W1 requirement projection is retained as its own axis; W3 source observations are not backfilled into W1 rows.

w3_module_source_axis.interpretation: Current source sets are retained separately and are not inferred as formal-case trace edges.

known_trace_gaps.subject: TST-11_REGRESSION_TARGET
known_trace_gaps.closure_condition: Name the current regression baseline and bind an exact non-empty formal case set before execution.

known_trace_gaps.subject: FORMAL_CASE_TO_AUTOMATED_FIXTURE
known_trace_gaps.closure_condition: Create reviewed case-to-fixture edges with exact source/build/environment evidence; do not infer them from suite names.

known_trace_gaps.subject: FORMAL_EXECUTION_EVIDENCE
known_trace_gaps.closure_condition: Append source/build/environment-bound evidence per formal test case without aggregating prior internal PASS.

allowed: The exact 279 canonical formal test IDs are projected in source order and match the W3 formal ID-set fingerprint.
W1 requirement, W2 design and W3 module/source/internal-evidence facts are linked as separate non-inferred axes.
Existing automated PASS evidence remains internal and source-bound.
Validation run001 failure is preserved and run002 deterministic generation/check PASS is bound as structure-only lineage.
The final W3 authoritative predecessor, common fingerprint and central sealing GO are bound without changing formal execution.
A deterministic structural test-to-module projection is derived through exact shared design IDs with matching forward/reverse pair digests.
prohibited: Any of the 279 formal tests passed, failed, skipped or executed.
Automated suite PASS counts may be summed into formal coverage or TST-20.
A formal case-to-fixture or case-to-current-module edge exists without an explicit reviewed record.
Actual-device E2E, TMAP, production, gate waiver or release eligibility.
Validation run002 PASS may be interpreted as any formal case PASS or release approval.
The superseded pre-final W3 trace may be treated as the current authoritative predecessor.
The derived transitive test-to-module projection may be described as an explicit direct formal trace edge or execution evidence.
